content.title: THE MINERAL {{DENTISTS}} WISH YOU KNEW ABOUT SOONER
facts: **Manganese** (Bone Builder) — activates the enzymes that build collagen and cartilage, so bones and joints hold up over time.
**Copper** (Collagen Helper) — works alongside iron to form connective tissue and keep blood vessels flexible instead of brittle.
Sources: **Cashews** | Dark Leafy Greens | Mushrooms | Dried Prunes
**Calcium** (Signal Sender) — beyond bones, it triggers muscle contractions and lets nerves fire messages fast.
Sources: **Sesame Seeds** | Bok Choy | Canned Salmon (with bones) | Figs
**Chromium** (Sugar Handler) — helps insulin do its job so blood sugar doesn't spike and crash all day.
Sources: **Broccoli** | Green Beans | Whole Wheat Bread | Grapes
**Phosphorus** (Energy Currency) — a key piece of ATP, the molecule your cells burn for actual energy.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Manganese doesn't get much attention, but it's the mineral your body quietly relies on to build collagen and cartilage — without enough of it, joints wear down faster than they should. Copper works as iron's silent partner: it helps form the connective tissue that keeps your blood vessels stretchy instead of stiff, which matters more as you get older. And chromium, often overlooked, helps insulin actually do its job so your blood sugar doesn't spike and crash after meals. Everyone's body is different, so pay attention to what yours needs.
